ABOUT DIGILOCKER

One trusted document layer for a billion possibilities

DigiLocker is a flagship initiative of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology under the Digital India programme. Operated by the National e-Governance Division, it lets citizens access authentic documents made available by registered government departments, educational institutions and other authorised organisations

Recognised at par with originals Issued documents available through DigiLocker are deemed at par with corresponding physical originals under Rule 9A of the Digital Locker Rules, 2016, subject to applicable law and issuer requirements

OUR NORTH STAR

Paperless governance that feels personal

Technology fades into the background. Trust, access and choice move to the foreground

VISION

Enable every citizen to access and use authentic digital documents with confidence

MISSION

Build inclusive, interoperable and privacy-conscious infrastructure at national scale

YOUR DIGILOCKER JOURNEY

From identity to access,
in four clear steps

Designed to keep every citizen informed and in control

01
Register

Create your account using a supported Aadhaar OTP or mobile OTP journey

02
Verify

Establish your identity through Aadhaar-based electronic KYC

03
Fetch

Bring eligible records directly from an issuer's authoritative system

04
Share

Authorise access after reviewing the requester, purpose and information needed

RESPONSIBLE BY DESIGN

Trust isn't a feature It's the foundation

DigiLocker supports document exchange while keeping privacy, security, inclusion and institutional accountability at the centre

Citizen-first
infrastructure
Citizen-centric

Clear language, informed choice and accessible interactions

Source-based trust

Records originate with accountable, authorised issuers

Consent & purpose

Share only what is needed for a stated service

Privacy by design

Safeguards span identity, access, transmission and storage

Interoperable

Common standards connect services across participating systems

Inclusive

Designed for varied languages, abilities, devices and connectivity

MANDATE & ROLE AS NATIONAL DPI

Public infrastructure, held to a public purpose

DigiLocker sits in the same tradition as other Indian digital public infrastructure: shared rails, open to eligible participants, designed so that a document issued once can be trusted everywhere it is needed

Our mandate

DigiLocker’s mandate is to enable trusted, citizen-controlled access to digital documents and to support their secure exchange across service-delivery ecosystems. It advances the Digital India objectives of digital infrastructure as a utility, governance and services on demand, and digital empowerment of citizens

Infrastructure as a utility
Governance & services on demand
Digital empowerment
DigiLocker as digital public infrastructure

Six characteristics that make the platform common infrastructure rather than a single-purpose app

01
National scale

Provides common digital rails that can be adopted by Central, State/UT and local government bodies, educational institutions and other eligible organisations

02
Public purpose

Reduces repeated submission of paper documents and enables citizens to reuse authentic records across supported services

03
Interoperability

Uses standardised document types, APIs and verification mechanisms to connect otherwise separate institutional systems

04
Authoritative source

Issuer-originated records remain linked to the department or organisation responsible for the document

05
Citizen agency

Supported sharing and requester access are designed around authentication, clear purpose and citizen consent

06
Open ecosystem

Enables approved issuers and requesters to build document-based public and private service journeys on common infrastructure

PUBLIC VALUE

Where the value shows up

Document trust is only useful when it changes what people and institutions can actually do

FOR CITIZENS
For citizens
Convenient access to eligible documents from multiple issuers in one account
Reduced need to carry, photocopy or repeatedly submit physical records
Faster sharing and verification in supported services
Greater reach across locations and devices, subject to connectivity and accessibility support
FOR INSTITUTIONS
For government & trusted organisations
Reusable digital issuance and verification infrastructure
Lower manual handling and faster document-based processing
Improved traceability, authenticity checks and lifecycle management
A common integration layer for nationwide and State-specific services

NATIONAL RELEVANCE

Digital trust,
made useful at scale

DigiLocker helps authoritative records move securely across supported journeys in education, transport, health, welfare and beyond

01

Less repeated document collection and fewer physical visits

02

Faster service delivery through source-based verification

03

Greater trust in records connected to authoritative issuers

04

Reusable national infrastructure for new citizen services
